limitations: All native scene tests use actual pinned Cesium/Proj4/Leaflet/WebGL and real pointer input. Offline imagery and inference outputs are fixed fixtures.
Live mode uses actual Esri imagery/elevation and samples a finite terrain height; detection output in this display test is fixed, not an accuracy benchmark.
Ownership counters and protected byte estimates do not establish total browser/native/GPU RAM or a general absence of leaks. Page-owned library/task pools intentionally persist.
64 is a suggested globe tile cache target; visible tiles can exceed it. Dense scenes, constrained physical devices, GPU contention and sustained thermal/memory behavior need profiling.
Normal CI/deployed source parity, Firefox/Safari and full 2D map reprojection remain outside this local verification.
modelExport: Existing scripts/export_onnx.py, model cache key and fresh/cache-hit validation flow preserved.
